review_corrections: Fixture fault branches now have distinct execution/beacon hashes while retaining a common bootstrap and packet checkpoint; different ABI states are never served under one execution hash.
Closed SQLite verifier connections explicitly close rather than relying on connection context-manager commit semantics.
Capture drains queued packets before stopping; the verifier compares captured count with kernel packet statistics.
Worker results and receipt hashes are independently reconciled against retained source request bytes in closed SQLite.
Artifact readers reject non-regular inputs, symlinks and path escapes, bound event lines and enforce the total artifact size; FIFO rejection is covered in the existing invalid-evidence test.
Runtime consumes an already sealed dataset and copies validated in-memory bytes; it no longer exports or renews state after permit consumption.
The v2 signed permit and reviewed configuration bind exact dataset/bundle hashes, run ID, creation/expiry and the fixed 1800-second maximum age.
Controller and children recheck freshness before setup/sockets and while processing; verifier correlates admission, captures and event timestamps.
